description: Gaven tijdens Davids voorbereiding; een nog niet bestaande tempelbouw uit de achtergrond verwijderd. Anatomie en nieuwe achtergrond visueel gecontroleerd.
prompt: Edit only the background setting of this historical Bible illustration for 1 Chronicles 29:6-9. The temple has NOT yet been built during David's preparation and donation gathering. Replace the monumental temple columns, construction scaffolding, workers building a temple and temple stairs with a simple ancient Jerusalem palace storage courtyard and a plain low stone wall. Keep the three foreground adult men carrying donated precious metals, wood and stones, their faces, fully modest robes, poses, baskets, proportions, correct two arms and hands; preserve photorealism, warm daylight and landscape framing. Show donations being brought for future construction, no temple already under construction, no modern objects or text.
